title: Thou One Begotten Son
description: Thou One Begotten Son in Tonic Solfa to AYLESBURY, doh is Ab: the solfa with the words, staff notation, 4 verses and a piano.
about: John Brownlie translated these words from the Greek service books for Hymns of the Greek Church (Edinburgh and London, 1900), headed “(From the Liturgy of St. John Chrysostom)”.
The book printed the words without tunes. They are in Short Metre (6.6.8.6), and this page sets them to AYLESBURY; any other Short Metre tune fits them as well.
underlay: Thou one Be-got-ten Son, E-ter-nal Word a-dored, Im-mor-tal while the a-ges run, And our Al-might-y Lord;

lines: Thou didst in cruel anguish die,
Save us, O Christ our God,
Save by Thy Cross, we pray;
Thou who didst bear the Father's rod,

source: John Brownlie, Hymns of the Greek Church (1900)
licence: Public domain: John Brownlie died in 1925.
credits: Translated by John Brownlie (1857–1925) from the Greek, public domain, as printed in Hymns of the Greek Church; set to AYLESBURY by NoteFusion, as words-only hymn books were sung.
